title: SizzleCraft timing.json
description: The timing contract every pipeline stage after S4 reads. validate-timing.mjs checks a project's timing.json against this. Unknown properties are permitted throughout: projects carry their own authoring metadata, and stages read only what they declare.

theme.description: A shipped background theme. write-build-html looks the name up in THEMES and silently falls back to midnight on a miss, so an unknown name or an object rendered the wrong theme instead of failing.

version.description: Authoring version. MUST be a string: `1.0` in JSON is the number 1, which collapses "1.10" and "1.1" onto the same value.

builderVersion.description: Version string displayed on the end card. Present only when the end card is enabled — see the allOf rule below.

project.description: Render parameters. Consumed by frame-capture and encode-mp4.

intake.description: Authoring calibration. wordsPerSecond x wpsSafetyMargin gives the word budget ceiling.

silence.description: Declares this segment DELIBERATELY silent — an intro slide, a gap, an intermission. Presence is the declaration; absence means a narrated segment, for which a missing `audio` still means the voice stage has not run. There is deliberately no duration field here: the authored window `endMs - startMs` is the duration, and a second source of truth for one number is free to drift from the first.

caption.description: The accessibility cue shown for the whole segment window, e.g. "[music]" or "[intermission]". Required, because there are no measured word boundaries to caption from — a blank cue is not 'no caption', it is a caption that renders as an empty box.

allOf.title: A silent segment carries no narration
allOf.description: Narration text plus a silence declaration is a contradiction with no safe resolution: whichever one a stage honours, the other was a lie. Stated as `const: ""` rather than `maxLength: 0` so ajv names the value it expected instead of reporting a length.

allOf.title: A disabled end card carries none of its fields
allOf.description: builderVersion, contentMs and outroMs exist to describe an end card. With no end card they must be ABSENT, not present-and-zero: zero reads as 'measured it, got nothing', which is a different claim from 'there is nothing to measure'. Each is a separate `not` so ajv reports each violation rather than one opaque failure.
